import RNA, random, sys, time

target = "(((((((((((((((((...(.(..((.(((.(((.((....).))).)))).).)..))..))))))).(((((..(.(..((.(((.(((((.(((.((((.((....).)))).))))).))).)))).).)..))..)((....))..))))(((((((((...))))).(((((...)))))(.(....).).)))).)))).((((.((((...(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))(((((((...))))))).(((((...)))))))))((((..((....))(..((..(..(.(.(((.((((.((....).)))).)))).)..)..).))..))))).))))))."
N=len(target)
st=[]; pairs=[]
for i,c in enumerate(target):
    if c=='(': st.append(i)
    elif c==')': pairs.append((st.pop(),i))
paired=[False]*N
pairmap={}
for i,j in pairs:
    paired[i]=paired[j]=True
    pairmap[i]=j; pairmap[j]=i
tpairs=set(pairs)

# start from current best
start=""

def fold_mfe(s):
    return RNA.fold_compound(s).mfe()[0]

def analyze(s):
    m=fold_mfe(s)
    st2=[]; mpairs=set()
    for i,c in enumerate(m):
        if c=='(': st2.append(i)
        elif c==')': mpairs.add((st2.pop(),i))
    missing=[(i,j) for (i,j) in pairs if (i,j) not in mpairs]
    spurious=list(mpairs - tpairs)
    d=sum(a!=b for a,b in zip(target,m))
    return d,missing,spurious,m

# Greedy targeted repair with SA
cur=start
bd,miss,spur,m=analyze(cur)
print("start bd",bd,flush=True)
best=cur; bd_best=bd
t0=time.time()

for it in range(4000):
    s=list(cur)
    # strengthen a missing pair -> GC
    if miss and (random.random()<0.5 or not spur):
        i,j=random.choice(miss)
        s[i],s[j]=('G','C') if random.random()<0.7 else ('C','G')
    elif spur:
        i,j=random.choice(spur)
        # break: if i unpaired in target -> A; if i paired in target with other -> weaken i to A/U
        if not paired[i]:
            s[i]=random.choice(['A','U'])
        elif not paired[j]:
            s[j]=random.choice(['A','U'])
        else:
            # both paired in target w/ others: this spurious is cross; weaken one
            s[i]=random.choice(['A','U'])
    else:
        i,j=random.choice(pairs)
        s[i],s[j]=('G','C') if random.random()<0.7 else ('C','G')
    cand=''.join(s)
    nd,nm,ns,_=analyze(cand)
    T=max(0.05, 1.0*(0.995**it))
    if nd<=bd or random.random()<2.718**(-(nd-bd)/T):
        cur=cand; bd=nd; miss=nm; spur=ns
        if bd<bd_best:
            bd_best=bd; best=cur
            print("it",it,"bd",bd,"miss",len(miss),"spur",len(spur),flush=True)
        if bd==0: break
    if time.time()-t0>170: break
print("BESTD",bd_best)
print("SEQ",best)
print("MFE",fold_mfe(best))
